cover.report_type: Interim Report: Seven days before a general election

_meta.notes: This filing uses the OLDER template (footer 04pccfindisc.doc): its interim choices are 'April 5 / Seven days before a primary election / September 15 / Seven days before a general election' — there is no 'October 28' box, so the clerk listing's 'October' corresponds to the checked 'Seven days before a general election'. The template also has a top-row 'Office' box (left blank) in addition to 'Office Sought' (used here). Column B is headed 'Aggregate Total' on this template. Line 1 Col A is written without cents ('29,494'; Line 4 repeats it as '29,494.—'). This filer writes 6 with a large open loop that can read as '10' at low resolution; the reading is corroborated by the form's own arithmetic on all seven lines. Neither amendment box is checked.
